title: Higher-degree projection support from infinity-boundary vanishing
statement:
Under the all-fields smaller-dimensional induction hypothesis, the same polynomial projection has weighted stalk vanishing in degrees q>2. Use torsion cohomological dimension as in [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd], the strict localization as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] when it occurs, and Krull dimension as in [def-kun-dimension]. The following verbatim Lean statement specifies all universes, hypotheses, scalar structures, sheaves and degrees:

theorem isZero_stalk_polynomialProjection_of_lowerDimension_of_gt_two
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ)
    (hIH : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] (m c : ℕ), m < n + 2 →
      (Spec (.of L)).HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE c →
      ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of L))
        [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a],
        topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (m : WithBot ℕ∞) →
          X.HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE (m + c))
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K))).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hM : N • 𝟙 M = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 < q) :
    let f : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K)) ⟶
        Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.rename
        (Fin.succ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 2))).toRingHom)
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K)))
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) K))),
      ((n + 2 : ℕ) : Cardinal.{u}) < (q : Cardinal.{u}) +
          residueFieldTrdeg b (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) →
        IsZero ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} s).obj
          (((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerived q).obj M))

source.place: Projective-line compactification and local Leray diagonal

proof.text: Reuse the private point-pullback, closed-section, infinity closed-immersion and row-column Leray helpers from AffineLineProjectionStalkBound via import all. Compactify the relative affine line in P1_B with open chart j and infinity section i. Exact restriction and the invertible open-immersion counit give j^*R^rj_*=0 for r>0; closed-support equivalence puts this sheaf in the essential image of i_*.
The closed direct image is exact and preserves injectives. The exact-inner derived-composition isomorphism and gi=id kill R^p g_*i_* for p>0, hence every mixed term with both degrees positive.

The proved bounded-torsion projective-line bound kills the q=0 row above degree two. The local infinity-boundary theorem kills the other end of the Leray diagonal at the specified point, using the closed-immersion counit and gi=id.

After exact inverse image all diagonal terms vanish. Compare derived composition with inverse image and the direct-image composition isomorphism to conclude vanishing of R^q f_*. Conservativity after algebraic closure extends it to separably closed geometric fields.
